results.content:
## Pixels has a nice selection of artist…

Pixels has a nice selection of artist work and the print quality is generally good. However, as a long-time Premium member, I’ve experienced persistent technical issues with my account, including artworks not displaying correctly after edits, frozen recent visit stats, and inconsistent thumbnail/banner updates.  
Tech Support responses are slow or not-at-all. The problems continue despite multiple tickets. Other artists’ accounts seem to update normally.  
The platform has potential, but these ongoing visibility and display glitches make it frustrating for serious artists trying to present and sell their work.  
I hope the team can address these backend issues soon.

results.title: Send feedback about your Pixel to Google - Pixel Phone Help
results.content:
You can send feedback about your phone to Google from your Settings app. This information helps improve Google's products and services for everyone.

Important:You're using a custom Android version. If these steps don't work for you, check with your device manufacturer.

Important:Some of these steps work only on Android 8.0 and up, on Pixel watches with the Pixel watch Android companion app version 4.1 and up, and Pixel Buds with the Pixel Buds companion app version 1.0.981607934 and up. Learn how to check your Android version.

## Send a feedback report

1. Open your phone's Settings app.
2. Scroll to the bottom and tap About phone Send feedback about this device.
3. To provide feedback to Google, follow the on screen instructions.

## Share a bug report [...] <!--THE END-->

1. Turn on Bug report shortcut.

### To reproduce the issue you want to report

1. When you notice the issue, simultaneously press and hold the Power and Volume Up buttons until the power menu appears.
2. Tap Bug report .
   
   - To confirm if the bug report is created, you can swipe down to check the notification.
   
   <!--THE END-->
   
   - When your bug report is ready to share, your device vibrates. This may take up to 2 minutes.

<!--THE END-->

1. To save the bug report to Drive, tap the bug report capture notification Drive Save.

### To send the bug report [...] ### To send the bug report

1. Open your Gmail app.
2. Select the email from the customer service agent.
3. Tap Reply Attachment Insert from Drive.
4. Navigate to where you saved your bug report.
5. Select the file.
6. Tap Select Send .

A dialog box appears asking if you want to grant others permission to view the file. To ensure Pixel experts can access the file, tap More options Anyone with the link Send.

### To turn off developer options

1. Open your phone’s Settings app.
2. Tap System Developer options.
3. Turn off Use developer options.
4. When prompted to restart your device, tap Restart.
